name: glass-nav-bar
title: Glass Nav Bar
description: The iOS 26 top bar in Liquid Glass: a centred title, a round glass back button and round glass actions that melt together on iOS 26. Wire it to a ScrollView with useGlassNavScroll() and the bar starts transparent, its glass fading in as content slides under it, while an optional large title shrinks and collapses into the bar — all on the native driver. Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, blur on older iOS, Android and web.
